name: inchi-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the inchi-js library, the inchi-api service, and the inchi.cheminfo.org playground.

scripts.build: npm run build-lib && npm run build -w inchi.cheminfo.org
scripts.check-types: npm run build-lib && npm run check-types -w inchi-js && npm run check-types -w inchi-api && npm run check-types -w inchi.cheminfo.org
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w inchi-api" "npm run dev -w inchi.cheminfo.org"
scripts.test: npm run test-only && npm run check-types && npm run eslint && npm run prettier
scripts.test-only: npm run test-only -w inchi-js && npm run test-bundle -w inchi-js && npm run test-only -w inchi-api && npm run test-only -w inchi.cheminfo.org
